paragraphs.text: Gyox is a Phyrexian native to New Phyrexia who had an affinity for both Vorinclex and Sheoldred during their rule of the plane. Having slaughtered enough of Vorinclex's champions to earn his respect, she stalked the Hunter Maze in search of worthy fodder for Sheoldred's coliseum.

Gyox has Phyrexian features, with a blend of tissue and metals forming her body. Her organic layer is a mix of writhing sinews and muscle underneath a jutting ribcage. She has four arms, and her metallic parts are her pair of clawed hands and her other pair of sharp-bladed hands, dripping with acidic ooze. Her hips are jagged metal plates, and her head is a lump of sinew enmeshed into a giant hammerhead-like metal headpiece supported by rigid vein-like coverings. She is lit from within by a harsh green glow.
It is unknown if Gyox survived the New Phyrexian Invasion .
